title: Product Designer, Payments
content: <p><strong>About the role</strong></p><p>We are looking for a product designer to join our Payments design team in Shanghai. You will shape the merchant dashboard experience used by millions of businesses.</p><p><strong>What you&rsquo;ll do</strong></p><ul><li>Design end-to-end flows for payment onboarding</li><li>Partner with product managers and engineers</li><li>Raise the craft bar through critique and mentorship</li></ul>
